verdict.rationale: Steel documents a clear captcha stance: a single flag handles captcha detection, solving and verification for the whole session, backed by dedicated Captchas API endpoints. Debug-URL human-in-the-loop control offers a possible manual fallback, but no evidence links it to captcha handling. The evidence also does not show how unsolved captchas are surfaced, so avoiding silent task failures is only implied. missing for 10: documented failure reporting or status signaling when solving fails, a captcha-specific human fallback workflow, the list of supported captcha types and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that solving works.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can rely on a documented captcha stance — automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support — instead of silent task failures
